g.text: more installers Europe needs — and at least half of
today's installers must be reskilled for heat pumps.
Schematic — shape of the gap, not a measured series.
In a survey of 345 installers, 30% named staffing the top barrier — 41% at firms with 6+ staff.
Lack of demand ranked higher overall (41%); staffing binds firms that already have work.
UK: about 3,000 heat-pump engineers today against at least 27,000 needed by 2028.
Sources: European Commission · EHPA · Nesta · retrieved 2026-09-10
